name: ClearCellsInExcelWorksheet
label: Clear Cells in Excel Worksheet
description: Clears a specified range or named cell in the provided worksheet or workbook.

fields.name: WorksheetInstance
fields.label: Worksheet Instance
fields.description: The specific worksheet instance to clear cells from. If not provided, the active worksheet will be used.

fields.name: ClearMode
fields.label: Clear Mode
fields.description: Specifies how to clear cells: Single Cell, Named Cells, Range of Cells, or Relative to Active Cell.

selectOptions.label: Single Cell
selectOptions.description: Clears a specific cell by column and row.

selectOptions.label: Named Cells
selectOptions.description: Clears cells based on a named range.

selectOptions.label: Range Relative to Active Cell
selectOptions.description: Clears cells relative to the active cell.

fields.name: Column
fields.label: Column
fields.description: The column letter (e.g., 'A', 'B') or number (e.g., 1, 2) of the target cell.

fields.name: Row
fields.label: Row
fields.description: The row number of the target cell.

fields.name: Name
fields.label: Name
fields.description: The name of the named range or cell to clear.

fields.name: StartColumn
fields.label: Start Column
fields.description: The starting column of the range to clear.

fields.name: EndColumn
fields.label: End Column
fields.description: The ending column of the range to clear.

fields.name: StartRow
fields.label: Start Row
fields.description: The starting row of the range to clear.

fields.name: EndRow
fields.label: End Row
fields.description: The ending row of the range to clear.

fields.name: XAxisDirection
fields.label: X-Axis Direction
fields.description: The direction to move from the currently active cell when clearing relatively.

selectOptions.label: Left
selectOptions.description: Moves left from the active cell.

selectOptions.label: Right
selectOptions.description: Moves right from the active cell.

fields.name: YAxisDirection
fields.label: Y-Axis Direction
fields.description: The direction to move from the currently active cell when clearing relatively.

fields.name: XOffset
fields.label: X Offset
fields.description: Number of cells to move horizontally from the active cell when clearing relatively.

fields.name: YOffset
fields.label: Y Offset
fields.description: Number of cells to move vertically from the active cell when clearing relatively.
